services.name: t3.new_thread
services.about: Create a thread on the T3 server; the reply is the new thread id.

services.name: t3.open
services.about: Open a thread: the t3.entries feed then shows its transcript.

services.name: t3.send
services.about: Send a message to a thread.

services.name: t3.answer
services.about: Answer a permission prompt: allow_once, allow_thread or deny.

services.name: t3.start_issue
services.about: Start a thread for an issue using a routing plan; the reply is the thread id.

services.name: t3.runner
services.about: Turn the issue runner (scheduled tasks) on or off.

services.name: t3.reconnect
services.about: Drop and re-open the server connection.

services.name: router.route
services.about: The local model reads an issue and answers with a plan: lane, provider and a short brief.

feeds.name: t3.threads
feeds.about: Threads from the T3 server, sorted by project.

feeds.name: github.issues
feeds.about: Issues labelled agent:ready in the pinned repositories.

feeds.name: t3.status
feeds.about: One row: running tasks, waiting prompts, the window nearest exhaustion.
